Patience is a virtue.

Nurture

(verb). nuôi dưỡng

These delicate plants need careful nurturing.

creativity

(noun). sự sáng tạo

Creativity and originality are more important than technical skill.

luminary

(noun). Danh nhân, ngôi sao sáng; người có uy tín lớn, người có ảnh hưởng lớn

He has played with all the great jazz luminaries.

broad

(adjective). rộng lớn

He's got broad shoulders.

assess

(verb). đánh giá

Accurately assessing environmental impacts is very complex.

inherit

(verb). kế thừa

She inherited a fortune from her father.

tendency

(noun). khuynh hướng

I have a tendency to talk too much when I'm nervous.

dysfunction

(noun). (y học) sự hoạt động khác thường của một cơ quan trong cơ thể

He's suffering from sexual dysfunction caused by depression.

schizophrenia

(noun). tâm thần phân liệt

Schizophrenia is a serious mental disorder in which people interpret reality abnormally.

maze

(noun). mê cung

We got lost in the maze.

discrepancy

(noun). sự khác biệt

What are the reasons for the discrepancy between girls' and boys' performance in school?

innate

(adjective). bẩm sinh

He never lost his innate sense of fun.

prowess

(noun). có kỹ năng xuất sắc

He was complimented on his prowess as an oarsman.

parental

(adjective). liên quan tới ba mẹ

The government repeatedly stressed its support for parental choice in the selection of a child's school.

disapproval

(noun). không đồng ý

He shook his head in disapproval.

entrance

(noun). lối vào

A separate entrance leads to the garden.

priest

(noun). Linh mục, thầy tu

The candles had been blessed by a priest.

fledgling

(noun). người non nớt, người thiếu kinh nghiệm

These people are fledgling democracies.

sublime

(adjective). Hùng vĩ, uy nghi

The location of the hotel is sublime.

hedonistic

(adjective). theo chủ nghĩa khoái lạc

This is a wonderful and evocative picture of the hedonistic excesses of Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald.

quantitative

(adjective). thiên về số lượng

Our employees receive a quantitative rating based on the dollar value of their sales.

millennium

(noun). thiên niên kỷ

Imagine what the world will be like at the end of the next millennium.

undue

(adjective). Quá đáng, quá mức, thái quá, quá mức phải chăng, quá mức đúng đắn

Such a high increase will impose an undue burden on the local tax payer.

strain

(noun). Sự căng, sự căng thẳng; trạng thái căng, trạng thái căng thẳng

She's a lot better than she was but she's still not ready to face the stresses and strains of a job.

encouragement

(noun). khuyến khích

Children need lots of encouragement from their parents.

even-handed

(adjective). công bằng, không thiên vị

Several broadcasters have been criticized for failing to give even-handed treatment to all the parties during the election campaign.

consequence

(noun). hậu quả

Not making a will can have serious consequences for your children and other family members.

smother

(verb). phủ đầy, phủ kín

The pasta was smothered with a creamy sauce.
